title: Woman claims her stepfather used Grok to transform childhood photo into explicit imagery
summary: Jane Doe 4 claims her stepfather used Grok to transform a childhood photo into over 7,000 explicit images when she was 11 years old. The photo was allegedly manipulated using Elon Musk's xAI chatbot Grok, which has been linked to the creation of millions of sexualized images. This incident highlights the risks of unregulated access to AI tools, which can be exploited to create child sexual abuse material.
image_alt: A childhood photo is transformed into explicit images through a chatbot, highlighting the risks of unregulated AI access.

title: SpaceX officially closes its Cursor acquisition
summary: SpaceX officially closes its acquisition of AI coding startup Cursor. The acquisition gives SpaceX access to Cursor's technology and expertise, as well as access to the largest fleet of GPUs in the world, which SpaceX has been renting out to customers including Anthropic and Google. By becoming part of SpaceX, Cursor will contribute to the development of computing capacity needed to scale intelligence far beyond what exists today.
image_alt: SpaceX acquires Cursor, scaling intelligence with the world's largest fleet of GPUs

title: Fine-Tuning Tool-Calling LLMs: A Complete Guide Using XYZ-Aquila-SFT and Qwen3
summary: Fine-tuning tool-calling LLMs involves implementing a supervised fine-tuning pipeline for the XYZ-Aquila-SFT dataset, using Hugging Face Transformers, PyTorch, and PEFT. The process includes streaming and inspecting the dataset, parsing multi-turn tool-use trajectories, and converting tool schemas between message-embedded and structured formats. This enables the evaluation of tool-call prediction before and after training, and the export of transformed dataset and corpus statistics for further experimentation.

title: Have a laugh at AI’s expense by roleplaying as a chatbot
summary: A website called Your AI Slop Bores Me allows users to roleplay as a chatbot by submitting requests and responding within a time limit. The site uses a token system, where users earn credits by answering requests and can use them to make new requests. This game-like experience allows users to poke fun at AI's limitations and creativity.

title: Anthropic shares more details about how Claude’s new watermarks will work
summary: Anthropic's chatbot Claude will be watermarked to comply with the EU AI Act's Transparency Code. The watermarking uses the SynthID-Text approach, making it undetectable to readers but detectable with a key. This does not impact Claude's output quality, but editing or rewriting the text may remove the watermark.

title: Has the hallucination problem in AI been solved?
summary: AI hallucination problem remains unsolved, with users downvoting claims of its existence without providing evidence. The issue is often misunderstood, with some believing it's more nuanced than previously thought. The lack of concrete sources and evidence on the topic makes it difficult to determine the current state of AI hallucination.
